questions.question: Which definition best matches “checking account”?
options: A scheme using electronic communication or transfer systems to obtain money or property by deception.
A debt instrument promising specified payments subject to issuer risk.
Failure to make a required payment on time.
A transaction account designed for payments, withdrawals, and deposits.
questions.explanation: Checking account means a transaction account designed for payments, withdrawals, and deposits.

A debt instrument promising specified payments subject to issuer risk.

The amount the insured pays before specified coverage begins.
